eos_records.label: Prescher et al. (2012), below 22 GPa BM3 (adopted V0)
eos_records.notes: Conditional parameter parity compares only K0 and K0_prime at their published printed precision. V0=154.5678863704812 A^3 per conventional Fe3C cell (Z=4) is adopted from recovery of the Figure 1 full-range calculated curve, and held fixed for catalog evaluation. It is not a printed or author-confirmed reference volume for any of the three fits. No experimental V0 error is available; covariance of correlated drawing vertices is not that error. The source's fixed/shared/refined V0 convention, original fit inputs, objective, weights, confidence and covariance remain unconfirmed. Published K coefficients and their printed errors are retained unchanged; source error confidence is unspecified. This is not author-workflow reproduction or a physical-validation/recommendation claim. The conditional replay uses Table S1 rows 1-10 (P<24 GPa), including 22.6 GPa, and fixed adopted V0 with absolute uniform 0.2 GPa pressure sigmas; volume errors are omitted. The source prose says below 22 GPa, whereas its figure indicates a change near 24 GPa. The source label and nominal 22 GPa limit are preserved. K0 error is not reproduced: 3 GPa published versus 3.670491 GPa in this replay (rounds to 4). This does not establish that the published error is incorrect. The main text rounds the upper limit to 47 GPa; Table S1 reaches 47.4 GPa. The nominal split ranges do not establish separate structural phases or a phase-stability envelope.

The conditional replay uses archived own/SHELX working volumes p10-p19 paired by run index with Table S1 pressures and absolute uniform 0.1 GPa pressure sigmas, omitting volume errors and fixing adopted V0.
